accepted: The frozen passive two-resonator fixture has receiver load voltage gain 1.395122497 at nominal tuning while load/source real-power ratio is 0.575447570; voltage amplification does not create energy.

All 3205 saved phasor rows agree with independent determinant formulas. All three saved transients agree with an exact constant-matrix propagator, including complete source, load, winding and stored-energy accounting.
Source backaction is represented by reflected impedance; reversing mutual coupling reverses receiver phase but preserves powers.
independence: Separate agent and implementation; same model family/shared brief, not external peer review. No producer numerical methods imported.
limitations: Synthetic linear lumped-element fixture, no apparatus measurements, core/radiation/thermal/environment/sensor effects.
Finite-grid comparisons do not certify a global optimum or a universal numerical enclosure.
Passive parameter domain excludes the singular inductance boundary |M|=sqrt(L1 L2); the frozen calculation is not a solver for invalid element values.
A receiver amplitude alone does not locate the origin of its drive; additional phase/calibration assumptions are identifying premises.
method: Explicit complex determinant and reflected impedance; capacitor-voltage-state matrix exponential with independent external Simpson quadrature
